/api/v1.guide: A GET reads and changes nothing. A setting is written with a PATCH of its resource, any of its fields at once, checked whole: if one field is refused, nothing is written. A setting written is live at once, or when its schema's 'applies' says; 'saved' in each settings reply says whether what runs is what is stored, and a POST of {} to the resource's save path stores it. A write may be refused for a moment with 409 busy: the charge's, the scale's and the gate's settings and the powder profile in use while a throw is under way, the motors' while the charge or a cleanup runs. GET /api/v1/schema describes every field. Weights are in the scale's own unit. The unit runs one job at a time: a charge or a cleanup. A charge is started with POST /api/v1/charge/start once a target is set, and throws until it is stopped: each throw waits for the scale to read zero, pours to the target, gives its verdict, and waits for the cup to be lifted and put back. POST /api/v1/stop stops whatever job runs, and never fails; a job that ended on a fault waits in 'fault' until a stop or a press at the unit. Follow GET /api/v1/events?after=N&wait=30 to see each change, from where you left off. The unit cannot know what is in the cup, nor whether the hopper holds powder: a zero and then a start pours onto whatever is on the pan. Start, and zero, only when a person has said an empty cup is on the pan.

actions.about: starts a firmware update (202): the menu takes it and it holds the screen; then PUT the image, unless it downloads. 409 busy also while a person has a screen open at the unit or a poll runs; 409 not_found for a download with nothing found

polls the update's source now (202): GET /api/v1/update's poll and found say what came of it. It also polls once each start, when the station joins. 409 busy while a poll or the update runs; 409 no_network on the unit's own access point

the update image (app.bin of the image GET /api/v1/update takes), application/octet-stream: written into the free slot as it comes, then checked whole (200, ready). 409 not_running unless receiving; 413 too_large; 400 not_an_image, wrong_chip, wrong_board, not_an_update, not_newer, wrong_slot or hash_mismatch, which end the job with nothing installed
restarts into a trial of the image (202); the unit comes back on it, confirmed once on its network, or on the one before. 409 not_ready unless ready
stops the update (202), or 200 with nothing to stop; the image written is never booted
restarts the unit once the reply is out (202)
erases the stored settings and restarts (202): the unit then leaves the network and comes back as its own access point, with a new id and host name. 400 confirm_missing without the confirmation
